body:
# SneakingOP v2 — Minecraft 1.21+ Datapack
> Shift to trigger chaos. Every sneak rolls the dice.

## Overview

SneakingOP transforms the humble sneak key into a slot machine of
destruction. Each press runs a weighted RNG against the game clock
and fires one of 23 possible events across three tiers — lucky,
unlucky, and legendary. No two sneaks feel the same.

---

## How It Works

* Player sneaks → 1-second cooldown starts
* `gametime mod 100` → score stored in `sop_rng`
* **0–64** → Lucky event (65% chance)
* **65–94** → Unlucky event (30% chance)
* **95–99** → Legendary event (5% chance)

Each tier has its own trigger function that runs a second
RNG roll to pick the specific sub-event.

---

## Custom Items

| Item            | Key Stat                          | Bonus Effects             |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------|---------------------------|
| **God Sword**   | +100 attack_damage attribute      | Fire Aspect, Looting 10   |
| **Void Bow**    | Power 5, Punch 2, Infinity, Flame | Strength II on pickup     |
| **Chaos Armor** | +20 armor + +20 max HP per piece  | +10 toughness, Resistance |
| **Zeus Trident**| +50 attack_damage attribute       | Channeling, Loyalty 3     |
| **Soul Scythe** | +75 attack_damage attribute       | +10 luck, Looting 10      |
| **Rocket Boots**| +0.3 speed, +1.5 jump (attrs)     | Speed V, Jump Boost V     |
| **Omega Pick**  | Efficiency 5, Fortune 3           | Haste X on pickup         |
| **Blaze Staff** | +60 attack_damage attribute       | Regen III, Absorb X       |
| **Chaos Sword** | +50 attack_damage attribute       | Random hit effects        |
| **Troll Pick**  | Efficiency 5, Fortune 3           | Haste V — classic chaos   |

> All power comes from `minecraft:attribute_modifiers` with unique
> `id` fields — bypasses Minecraft's enchantment caps entirely.

---

## Legendary Events  (5%)

* **God Mode** — Resistance 255 + every positive buff for 30s
* **Chaos Armory** — Full armor set + God Sword + Void Bow drop
* **Blood Moon** — Thunder + buffed zombie horde + charged creeper
* **Ascension** — Rocket Boots + flight effects for 60s
* **Loot Rain** — 5 legendary loot spawns overhead
* **Void Chest** — End chest with max-tier loot table
* **Baby Dragon** — 100hp allay companion
* **MEGA (rare)** — Meteor Strike / Lightning Storm / Time Warp / Void Rift

---

## Lucky Events  (65%)

* Custom item drop (1 of 10 items, random)
* Stacked effects — all positive potions, max level
* XP Bomb — +2500 XP instantly
* Divine Feast — 10 enchanted golden apples + more
* Lucky chest · Lucky drops · XP orbs · Random effects

---

## Unlucky Events  (30%)

* Mob Army — buffed zombi
